login.title: Sign in — mock authentication service
login.heading: Sign in
login.linkAccount: Link your account. A federation partner signed you in as {name}, and that account is not linked to it yet. Sign in here as {name} to link them; Cancel links nothing.
login.passkeysOff: Passkeys are switched off in this realm (webauthn.enabled), so neither passkey option is offered. A passkey already registered still works.
login.keySecond: Use a passkey as a second step (WebAuthn)
login.keySecondNotAvailable: — not available: this partner is configured for a passkey instead of a password
login.keySecondRequiredSecond: — required after a password: this request demands a passkey as the second factor
login.keySecondRequired: — required after a password: this request demands a passkey, alone or as the second factor
login.keySecondOff: A passkey as a second step is switched off here (webauthn.mfaAllowed).
login.keyOnly: Sign in with a passkey instead of a password (no password step, and the tokens will say one factor)
login.keyOnlyAccepted: — accepted: this request demands a passkey
login.keyOnlyNotAvailable: — not available: this request demands two factors
login.keyOnlyRequiredRelationship: — required: the federation relationship "{name}" configures this
login.keyOnlyRequiredApplication: — required: the application allows a passkey alone on this screen
login.keyOnlyOff: A passkey instead of a password is switched off here (webauthn.primaryAllowed).
login.keyOnlyCannotComplete: This sign-in cannot complete: the federation relationship "{name}" configures a mechanism this realm has turned off.
login.rememberNote: — recognises it next time with a cookie. Do not tick on a shared computer.
login.anonymousTitle: Continue as the anonymous principal. The flow goes on and tokens may be issued, but the session records that nobody authenticated — so an application requiring ALL_AUTHENTICATED_USERS will refuse it. Anything typed above is ignored.
login.noScreen: This application is not signed in to on this screen. Use one of the ways it allows, below.
login.metaChecked: Your password is checked against your account.
login.metaPasswordlessChecked: Passwordless: the password field is not read, and a passkey you registered for signing in is the only factor. A passkey is added at /portal/keys after signing in, never here.
login.metaUnchecked: No password is checked. The username you enter is the identity the issued tokens describe.
login.metaPasswordlessUnchecked: Passwordless: the password field is not read at all, and the passkey becomes the only factor — a passkey is registered for this username on first use, so the first person to claim a name here gets it. This service authenticates nobody; that is the same statement as the line above and not a weaker one.
login.metaPasskey: Sign in with a passkey: no username — the passkey names your account, and it must verify you with its PIN or biometric, so the tokens say two factors (amr ["hwk","user"], acr "mfa").
